items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: he played some background on the Paul Whiteman record of “Melancholy Baby” that Jack Fulton sang.

ctx.x: He’s looked on as almost a legend now, Bix. And so was he really popular in the 20s also? But you hadn’t heard of him really until he died. Is that right?

Right, but I had heard him play and didn’t know it. But I was impressed with a record that he made, he played some background on the Paul Whiteman record of “Melancholy Baby” that Jack Fulton sang. And that’s why — the first time I heard him play and I was © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
very impressed by the little thing he did behind the vocal, not realizing that those were the two that I saw at that concert. I didn’t know their names.
